cards.name: hero
cards.question: Free Text on Photo Maker, No Sign-up
cards.qualifier: Add a photo or pick a background color, type your text, choose a style and download a finished image sized for Instagram, Stories, TikTok or X. Nothing is uploaded.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to add text to an image

steps.title: Add a photo, or don't
steps.text: Tap Add a photo or drop it here (optional).

steps.title: Type your text
steps.text: Line breaks you type are kept, and long lines wrap on their own.

steps.title: Pick a style
steps.text: Plain, Band, Outline or Breaking news (more on each below).

cards.name: add-text-to-image
cards.title: Add text to image styles: plain, band and outline

groups.label: Plain
groups.text: Text in any color you pick with Text color.

groups.label: Band
groups.text: A semi-transparent strip runs across the full width behind your text.

groups.label: Outline
groups.text: Each letter gets a thick outline in black or white.

cards.name: text-on-photo-or
cards.title: Text on photo or on a plain background

groups.label: Use your own photo
groups.text: When you add a photo, the output size switches to Original.

groups.label: Quote images on a solid color
groups.text: Without a photo, pick one of eight swatches or any color with the picker.

groups.label: Long text and line breaks
groups.text: Text wraps to fit the margins.

cards.name: specs
cards.what: Sizes for Instagram, Stories, TikTok and X: 1:1

cards.name: ideas-for-text-on
cards.title: Ideas for text on photo posts

groups.label: Reels and TikTok covers
groups.text: Use 9:16 with the Band style at Top or Middle.

groups.label: Quote images and tips
groups.text: Use 1:1 or 4:5 with Plain text on a solid color.
